members.name: Evaluate
members.signature: static bool Evaluate(const TypeDescriptor& desc, const void* component, const char* condition)
members.doc:
True when `condition` ("name" / "!name", matching a sibling
property's serialized key or display name) evaluates truthy against
the live component. Bools read their value; integral types read
non-zero. A condition naming nothing resolvable is TRUE — a typo
must not brick editing of the row it guards.

types.doc:

pointer passed through opaquely) or `Custom` (resolved out-of-band). The

call — it only guides arg marshalling.

members.name: Server
members.doc:
RPC direction annotations (MFUNCTION(Server) / (Client) / (Multicast)).
Server = client → server (the owning client may invoke it on the
authority); Client = server → the owning client; Multicast = server →
every client. A call in the wrong direction is refused at the send
site. Reliable requests the reliable channel.

types.name: ArrayOps
types.doc:
Type-erased std::vector access for PropertyType::Array fields. The
generated .refl.cpp knows the element type and points the property at
TArrayOpsFor<Elem>::Get(); serializer/inspector walk elements through
these without compile-time knowledge of Elem.

members.name: size_t
members.doc:
sizeof(Elem). PropertyInfo carries the ELEMENT TYPE but no element
size, and the type does not pin one (an enum's width follows its
underlying type), so the replicator reads the stride from here rather
than guessing it. Null on a hand-written ops table that predates this.

members.name: void
members.doc:
The structural edits an inspector performs on a list. resize + at is
not enough to build them: shifting elements to open a hole, or copying
one, would have to move raw bytes, and a vector element is not
relocatable that way the moment it owns storage — std::string and a
nested std::vector both self-destruct under a memcpy relocation, and
both are shipped element types. Null on a hand-written ops table that
predates this, so a caller must check before offering the control.

types.doc:

ascending key order whatever the container, so an unordered map serializes
and lists the same way every time. A caller that does not know the key type
reads one into a temporary the ops construct (withKey), then looks it up.

members.name: LayerMask
members.doc:
uint32_t field is a 32-slot layer bitmask. The inspector resolves the
bit names through the project's layer registry and edits it as a
multi-select instead of a number.

members.name: NetQuantizeShift
members.doc:
MNET_QUANTIZE: how the packed replication codec narrows a replicated
float, vector or quaternion. A three-bit field inside the flags, so a
quantized row needs no new PropertyInfo member — every positional
aggregate in the tree stays valid. Zero = lossless 32-bit floats.

members.name: RepConditionShift
members.doc:
MNET_CONDITION: which peers a replicated field reaches (UE's COND_*).
A three-bit field like the quantizer, so no PropertyInfo member moves.
Zero = every peer the object is relevant to.

members.name: elementType
members.doc:
Tail members with defaults so every existing positional aggregate
init stays valid. type == Array: elementType + arrayOps required,
structDesc set when elementType == Struct, elementEnumDesc when Enum.
type == Struct: structDesc points at the nested type's descriptor.

members.name: void
members.doc:
RepNotify (MREPLICATED_USING): fired by the replication apply path
when this property's bytes actually change on a receiver. MHT emits
a captureless-lambda thunk over the owning type's member function;
nullptr on every other property.

members.name: editCondition
members.doc:
MOWO_EDIT_CONDITION: sibling-property gate ("name" / "!name") the
inspector evaluates to grey this row. nullptr = always editable.

members.name: category
members.doc:
MOWO_CATEGORY: inspector section this row files under inside its
component block, first-appearance ordered. nullptr = the unnamed
leading section.

members.name: assetType
members.doc:
MOWO_ASSET_TYPE: which AssetType an asset-ref row accepts, as the
type's serialized name ("Curve", "Mesh", ...). The inspector filters
its picker by this. It lives on the PROPERTY because the alternative —
an editor-side table keyed by (component name, field name) — has to be
edited every time a field is added, and drifts silently into showing
every asset in the project when a name changes. nullptr = unfiltered.

members.name: units
members.doc:
MOWO_UNITS: the physical unit the field's STORED number is in ("m",
"deg", "rad", "s", "kg", ...). The inspector shows it as a suffix and
converts where the stored unit is not the one authors think in —
rotation is radians on the wire and degrees in every UI, which every
rotation row used to hand-code against a component name. It lives on the
PROPERTY because the alternative is an editor-side table keyed by
(component, field) that silently goes stale on a rename. nullptr =
unitless.

members.name: keyType
members.doc:
type == Map: the key's type and the ops (the VALUE type is elementType,
with structDesc for a struct value). type == Set: setOps, with the
element type in elementType. Keys and set elements are the fixed-width
and string types (Int, UInt32, UUID, String).

members.name: ReadEnum
members.doc:
Enum storage follows the declared underlying type, and `enum class E :
uint8_t` is the common form. Reading the field as int32_t runs past it
into padding, so the value only matched the descriptor when those bytes
happened to be zero — go through `size` in both directions instead.

members.name: version
members.doc:
Bump whenever the serialized layout changes incompatibly (field
rename, semantic shift, unit change). The serializer writes `_version`
into every emitted MDF node; when it is missing the deserializer
assumes 1, which keeps pre-versioning saves loading.

members.name: void
functions
members.doc:
Reflected callable methods (MFUNCTION). Descriptors without methods
leave these zero via aggregate init. The call-by-reflection layer
looks a method up by name and invokes it through FunctionInfo::invoke.

members.name: instanceSize
members.doc:
CDO support, filled by the MHT codegen; zero for descriptors that
predate it, in which case delta-serialization falls back to writing
every property. instanceSize plus placement-new default construction
let the serializer diff against a Class Default Object so scenes
persist only properties that differ from the defaults.

members.name: category
members.doc:
Editor Add Component grouping ("Rendering", "Physics", ...). Set by
a struct-level MCATEGORY annotation; null buckets under "General".

members.name: description
members.doc:
One-line authored summary for the Add Component menu, from a
struct-level MOWO_TOOLTIP. Null when the component never wrote one, in
which case the picker falls back to a line derived from the type name,
the category and the property count — which says what the component IS
named, never what it does.
